title: Bedrock Anthropic passthrough: only Anthropic models, bearer-token auth, and client credentials dropped
answers: Bedrock passthrough returns 501 for IAM role or access key endpoint
gateway messages route rejects non-Claude model on Bedrock with 400
client authorization header leaks to Bedrock
why does anthropic passthrough not work for SigV4 Bedrock endpoints
body:
Invariant: `AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough` accepts only Anthropic models (`self._underlying_provider == AmazonBedrockModelProvider.ANTHROPIC`, else 400) and only bearer-token auth (`self._is_token_auth`, else 501, the same status the provider uses for unsupported auth modes).
Invariant: client auth headers are always removed with `_drop_client_auth_headers` before `self._get_token_auth_headers()` is merged in, so the endpoint's Bedrock key is the only credential sent. A credential agent's own key is dropped too.
What breaks if skipped: a SigV4 endpoint would get a bearer-token request it cannot authenticate, a non-Anthropic model would be sent Anthropic-shaped bodies, and a client key would reach Bedrock.
Constraints: SigV4 support (boto3 `invoke_model`) was explicitly left out of that change, so the 501 is intentional for now.
applies: Changes to the Bedrock passthrough auth/model guards or to passthrough header handling in the gateway providers.
says: Bedrock gateway endpoints configured with IAM roles or access keys return 501 errors.
Sending non-Claude models through the Bedrock chat messages route returns bad request.
Client authentication tokens are unexpectedly forwarding directly to upstream Bedrock services.
Support AWS credentials and IAM authentication on Bedrock passthrough gateway routes.
Strip caller authorization headers so Bedrock routes only use endpoint credentials.
search: Bedrock Anthropic passthrough requires Anthropic models and bearer-token authentication while stripping client authorization headers. AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py returns 400 for non-Anthropic providers and 501 when token authentication is not enabled, intentionally excluding SigV4 and boto3 invoke_model. Before merging token auth headers, _drop_client_auth_headers from mlflow/gateway/providers/base.py removes client and credential agent credentials so only the endpoint Bedrock key is sent.
